puzzles.g: Capture the enemy Lancer with your Pike.
puzzles.why: Pikes capture the hex to their left or right, not straight ahead.

puzzles.g: Promote your Pike by moving it to the far edge.
puzzles.why: A Pike that reaches the far edge becomes a Seer.

puzzles.g: Take the enemy Core with your Seer after it has moved.
puzzles.why: Seers slide along long diagonals. An unmoved Core is protected from Seers.

puzzles.g: Take the enemy Core with your Runner. The Pike wall is in the way.
puzzles.why: A Runner jump ignores whatever stands in between.

puzzles.g: Take the enemy Core with your Hopper.
puzzles.why: The Hopper vaulted your own Pike and landed on the Core.

puzzles.g: Take the enemy Core with your Phantom.
puzzles.why: Phantoms pass through pieces, so a wall cannot stop them.

puzzles.g: Use your Bomber to remove at least 4 enemy pieces in one capture.
puzzles.why: Capturing the middle of a cluster removes every neighbor too.

puzzles.g: Move your Frostbinder so the enemy Lancer cannot move.
puzzles.why: Enemy pieces touching a Frostbinder cannot move.

puzzles.g: Capture the enemy Bulwark. Try the Seer first: the Pike it targets is shielded.
puzzles.why: Shielded pieces cannot be captured, but the Bulwark itself can.

puzzles.g: Your Core is attacked by the Runner. Make it safe.
puzzles.why: Capturing the attacker or stepping away both save the Core.

puzzles.g: The Lancer attacks your Core. Save it by swapping with your Swapper.
puzzles.why: The swap moved your Core out of the Lancer line.

puzzles.g: Remove the enemy Lancer with your Archer without moving it.
puzzles.why: Archers shoot 2 to 3 hexes away and never leave their hex.

puzzles.g: Win by shoving the enemy Core off the board with your Titan.
puzzles.why: A Titan pushes enemies one hex. Pushed off the board means destroyed.

puzzles.g: Win over at least 3 enemy Pikes with one Witch move.
puzzles.why: After a Witch moves, enemy Pikes touching it join you.

puzzles.g: Freeze the enemy Lancer with your Frostbinder, then capture it with your Lancer.
puzzles.why: Freeze first to take away the target's escape, then finish with a second piece.

puzzles.g: Use your Bomber to clear the Pike blocking your Lancer, then capture the enemy Lancer.
puzzles.why: The Bomber clears the lane; your Lancer uses the opening to reach the target.

puzzles.g: Swap your Core out of the Lancer's line, then capture that Lancer.
puzzles.why: A strong defense can create time for a counterattack.

The Bomber clears the blocker first
lessons.next: The lane is open. Slide your Lancer through and take the target.

lessons.learn: A defensive move can also create a tempo: save your Core by swapping it out of danger, then use another piece to remove the attacker.
lessons.q: What is the two-step plan?
a: Wait for the attacker to move
Swap the Core to safety, then capture the attacker
Swap the Core with the attacker
lessons.next: Your Core is safe. Now use your Lancer to remove the threat.

lessons.learn: Pikes move forward but capture to either side. An enemy beside a Pike can be in danger even when it is not in front.
lessons.q: Where can a Pike capture?
a: One hex to the left or right
